title: AMD action: getupdatedreferringproviders
description: List referring providers (external doctors who refer into this practice) added or modified since an ISO 8601 since timestamp. Empty since returns the full referring-provider roster (bootstrap pull). Returns since, full_pull, count, by_specialty, and a refproviders list. refproviders rows: refprovider_id, name, code, specialty, practicename. Off-peak Tier 1.

since.description: Saved servertime; if empty, AMD returns all referring providers. Omit or pass empty string for bootstrap full-pull.
